scope: Narrow web saved-book cover controls correction, matching native availability check.
change: Photo framing controls now require an actual photoUrl or videoUrl from the selected cover page. A text-only page object by itself is no longer enough.
fixtureChanges: Adds one synthetic text-only story and a real designer/create/edit/save journey. The gallery normalizes its potentially absent photo to undefined.

browser.regression: A newly created saved text-only book exposes zero horizontal-position, vertical-position, zoom or reset-framing controls. Its writing is editable and successfully persisted. Existing photo-book editor still exposes all three framing sliders.

limits: Browser uses the actual web designer, editor and cover components with synthetic Auth/RPC and localStorage persistence. This is not hosted Supabase or physical-device acceptance.
The production change is limited to the cover-controls availability condition.
